format: Four first-round groups of four teams, followed by two second-phase groups of four teams; the group winners met in the final and the runners-up met in the third-place match.

notes: Caszely was sent off in the 67th minute.
Richards was sent off in the 83rd minute.
N'daye was sent off in the 23rd minute.
Morena was sent off in the 89th minute.
Jean-Joseph was expelled from the tournament after a positive antidoping test.
Luis Pereira was sent off in the 84th minute.
Tomaszewski saved Tapper's penalty in the 64th minute.
The match was delayed by half an hour because of an extremely wet pitch.
Tomaszewski saved Hoeness's penalty in the 53rd minute.
This was the first World Cup final to feature a penalty before the defending champions had touched the ball.
